metadata.question: Did the volcanic plume from Nyamulagira at Virunga National Park drift eastward on February 20, 2025, captured by Landsat 8?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Nyamulagira volcano at Virunga National Park (DRC, ~1.41°S, 29.20°E) - Date: February 20, 2025 - Collection: Landsat 8 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2) - Need to check for volcanic plume presence and direction 2. Masking strategy: - Should NOT mask clouds heavily since we're looking for a volcanic plume (which may appear cloud-like) - Use RGB or thermal bands to detect plume - Check aerosol/gas indicators if possible 3. Logic: - C1: If no Landsat 8 images on Feb 20, 2025 - C2: If image exists but no valid pixels - C3: If calculation fails - A: If plume detected drifting eastward - B: If no plume or plume drifts in different direction ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location and time const nyamulagira = ee.Geometry.Point([29.20, -1.41]); const roi = nyamulagira.buffer(50000); // 50km radius to capture plume drift const startDate = '2025-02-20'; const endDate = '2025-02-21'; console.log("Searching for Landsat 8 images at Nyamulagira on Feb 20, 2025..."); // 2. Get Landsat 8 Collection let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(nyamulagira) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const count = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images found: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log("No Landsat 8 imagery available for this date/location."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Get the image and check aerosol band (SR_QA_AEROSOL) and visual bands const image = collection.first(); // Scale factors for Landsat 8 Collection 2 const opticalBands = image.select(['SR_B.*']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); // Check valid pixel count in the region const validPixels = await opticalBands.select('SR_B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B4').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels in ROI: ${validPixels}`); if (validPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Analyze plume direction using aerosol optical depth indicators // Create east and west regions from volcano center const westRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([29.10, -1.51, 29.20, -1.31]); const eastRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([29.20, -1.51, 29.40, -1.31]); // Use blue band (often elevated in volcanic plumes) and aerosol indicators const blueBand = opticalBands.select('SR_B2'); const westMean = await blueBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: westRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B2').getInfo(); const eastMean = await blueBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: eastRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B2').getInfo(); console.log(`Blue band mean - West: ${westMean ? westMean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Blue band mean - East: ${eastMean ? eastMean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); if (westMean === null || eastMean === null) { console.log("Failed to calculate plume indicators."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Determine if plume drifted eastward // Eastward drift indicated by higher reflectance/aerosol in east vs west const driftRatio = eastMean / westMean; console.log(`East/West ratio: ${driftRatio.toFixed(3)}`); // If eastern region shows significantly higher signal (>1.2x), plume drifted east if (driftRatio > 1.2) { console.log("Evidence of eastward plume drift detected."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("No clear eastward plume drift detected."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
